seats.notes: Two-colour BG build: removal (Prey Upon, Bump in the Night), Bloodline Keeper as the bomb, Spider Spawning and Somberwald Spider for fliers and stalls, and cheap green bodies. Cut the red cards and Traveler's Amulet, Altar's Reap and Unburial Rites; 23 spells with 10 Forest and 7 Swamp.

White-red aggro-midrange: white is the deep colour with Fiend Hunters, Priests and fliers, and red adds Crossway Vampires, Pitchburn Devils and removal. I cut Ghost Quarter, Rally the Peasants, Divine Reckoning and the blue, green and black cards to keep the mana clean.

…Into the Maw of Hell, Curse of the Pierced Heart and Blazing Torch, with Bloodgift Demon, Falkenrath Marauders and Balefire Dragon as threats. I cut the thin green and white cards and the weak Brain Weevil, and ran 10 Mountain and 7 Swamp for the red-heavy pips with BB in Demon and Ghoulraiser.

…tempo deck: efficient creatures (Skaab Ruinator, Stitched Drake, Pitchburn Devils, Riot Devils), removal (Claustrophobia, Sensory Deprivation, Harvest Pyre x2, Lost in the Mist), and Frightful Delusion for interaction. Cut Trepanation Blade and the marginal cards to reach 23 spells with 17 lands.

…build around cheap removal (Victim of Night, Corpse Lunge x2), deathtouch and cheap bodies (Typhoid Rats x2, Walking Corpse), Woodland Sleuth, Banshee, Noble, Spider and Moan as the late game. I cut Caravan Vigil to make 23 spells, with a 9 Swamp / 8 Forest split for the heavier black pips.

…artifacts: 16 blue cards plus Galvanic Juggernaut, Blazing Torch, Creepy Doll, Mask of Avacyn, Demonmail Hauberk, Cobbled Wings and Grimoire of the Dead. Left out the red, white, and black cards since they are too few to support a second colour, and kept 17 lands (Ghost Quarter plus 16 Islands).

…build around cheap removal (Dead Weight x2, Victim of Night, Bonds of Faith, Urgent Exorcism, Ghostly Possession), fliers (Abbey Griffin, Voiceless Spirit, Gallows Warden x2, Midnight Haunting) and cheap white bodies. Green cards and the weak filler are cut; Morkrut Banshee is the late finisher.

…Zombies), plus Grasp of Phantoms, Lost in the Mist, Night Terrors, Spectral Flight, Think Twice, Forbidden Alchemy, Silent Departure, Altar's Reap, and Unburial Rites. Cut red splash cards (Olivia, Balefire, Nightbird's Clutches) and the weaker Frightful Delusion, Dissipate, and Army of the Damned.
